# The House of Mouth™

> Australia's leading provider of professional-grade teeth whitening and comprehensive oral care products from 20+ global brands.

The House of Mouth™ offers both at-home DIY whitening solutions and in-chair professional treatments on the Gold Coast, alongside a curated selection of oral care products from premium brands like Pola, Opalescence, Philips, Oral-B, and Colgate. The company specializes in custom-fit whitening services, dental hygiene treatments, and cosmetic dental enhancements.
